responsibility: This header declares the public transactional-memory support interface used across GCC. It defines the transaction property-bit constants that match libitm, and exposes helper APIs for computing transaction flags, recognizing TM-ending statements or declarations, building abort calls, querying TM safety/purity/cancel behavior, and recording runtime replacement functions. It is the shared declaration layer for the transactional-memory lowering and IPA machinery in trans-mem.cc.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/trans-mem.cc, which contains the lowering and IPA implementation for transactional memory, this header is the shared declaration file: it publishes the libitm-matching property-bit constants and the helper functions other GCC code uses to query or build TM-related operations.
